relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: A billed revenue row as represented in billing sources with its stated identifiers, counterparty name, amount, currency, period, and payment status.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to one invoice object in sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per invoice_id and one tuple with fields copied verbatim from the billing JSON row.

relations.name: invoice_tax_identifier
relations.meaning: The VAT or tax identifier printed on an invoice when the billing source supplies one.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to the vat_or_tax_id field on the matching billing JSON row; omit tuple when the field is empty.
relations.construction_rule: C1: join invoice_record by invoice referent; copy non-empty vat_or_tax_id from billing source.

relations.name: crm_account_record
relations.meaning: A CRM account row as represented in the CRM export with its stated commercial identity fields.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to one row in sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per crm_account_id and one tuple with CSV fields copied verbatim.

relations.name: registry_company_record
relations.meaning: A company registry entry with registered legal name, number, jurisdiction, and registry status as stated in the registry source.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to one row in sources/company_registry.csv by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one referent per company_number and one tuple with CSV fields copied verbatim.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: Contract document metadata as stated in contract front matter, including counterparty name, effective date, term language, and explicit expiry when present.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to one markdown file under sources/contracts/; contract_id is the filename without extension.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse each sources/contracts/*.md header fields into one referent and one metadata tuple; expiry_date is empty when not explicitly stated.

relations.name: contract_body_text
relations.meaning: Full textual content of a contract document as represented in the contract source file.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to the complete markdown body of the matching file in sources/contracts/.
relations.construction_rule: C1: read the full contract markdown for each contract referent and store as body_text.

relations.name: typed_identifier
relations.meaning: Canonical typed identifier string for a referent in the Purpose B/C identifier forms (crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:).
relations.grounding_contract: Deterministic mapping from compiled referent kind and source-native key to the identifier forms declared in 00_intention_contract.json.
relations.construction_rule: C1: derive identifier from referent class and source field—crm:<crm_account_id>, billing:<billed_name>, registry:<company_number>, contract:<filename without .md>.

relations.name: legal_name_variant
relations.meaning: Two name strings are exact legal-form variants of the same registered name under deterministic suffix and punctuation normalization.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to the normalization rule and the two source name strings; no interpretive entity merge.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit symmetric pairs where names differ only by approved legal-form tokens (e.g., Ltd vs Limited) after case-folding and punctuation normalization.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate pairs among names appearing on invoices, CRM accounts, contract counterparties, and registry legal_name fields that share a normalized core token sequence.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: C2: assert bounded pairwise judgments over typed_identifier pairs; C3: ground each persistent assertion with an evidence packet.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit ordered pairs of typed identifiers required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to its billed name, governing contract identifier, and candidate registry identifiers suggested by shared VAT/tax id, legal_name_variant, or exact name correspondence; exclude pairs already closed by legal_name_variant mechanical tuples.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two typed identifiers refer to the same legal counterparty cannot be established confidently from authoritative sources.

relations.name: acquisition_clause_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether grounded contract text contains an acquisition-relevant clause of the stated kind under Purpose A policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_body_text spans and interpretive rationale; ACCEPT requires explicit textual support for the kind.
relations.construction_rule: C2: judge each (contract, kind) candidate; C3: persist ACCEPT, REJECT, or UNRESOLVED with evidence grounded in contract text.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cross each contract referent with allowed acquisition kinds from contracts/purpose_a.json.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Contract language does not support a confident present or absent finding for the acquisition-relevant kind.

relations.name: obligation_kind_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether grounded contract text contains a commercial obligation provision of the stated kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term) under Purpose C policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_body_text spans and interpretive rationale for the obligation kind.
relations.construction_rule: C2: judge each (contract, kind) candidate; C3: persist ACCEPT, REJECT, or UNRESOLVED with evidence grounded in contract text.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cross each contract referent with obligation kinds allowed in contracts/purpose_c.json.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Contract language does not support a confident present or absent finding for the obligation kind.

relations.name: active_contract_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether a contract counts as in-force under the shared Purpose A/C active-contract policy (expired statement of work is not active).
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_record dates, term_description, expiry_date, and document type; ACTIVE or INACTIVE must follow the purpose active-contract rule.
relations.construction_rule: C2: apply purpose active-contract policy to each contract referent using world-grounded status facts; C3: persist ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent compiled from sources/contracts/.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Source contract status and term facts are insufficient to classify the contract as active or inactive under purpose policy.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoice whose billing-source status is open.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation grounded to invoice_record.status equal to the literal open.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT invoice FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.meaning: Purpose A output row: a represented billed invoice tied to an active contract bearing at least one acquisition-relevant clause, with association asserted or unresolved per identity policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs: invoice_record, contract_record, active_contract_judgment, acquisition_clause_judgment, identity_judgment; association maps SAME_ENTITY to asserted and UNRESOLVED to unresolved per contracts/purpose_a.json.
relations.construction_rule: C4: include invoices where the counterparty links—asserted or unresolved via identity_judgment—to a contract that is ACTIVE under active_contract_judgment and has ACCEPT on at least one acquisition_clause_judgment kind allowed for Purpose A.

relations.name: purpose_b_reconciliation_link
relations.meaning: Purpose B output link connecting typed identifiers with SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED per identity_judgment and contracts/purpose_b.json orientation rules.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over typed_identifier and identity_judgment; completeness claim covers required CRM–billing–contract–registry connectivity links.
relations.construction_rule: C4: emit each required connectivity pair in canonical left/right order with epistemic copied from identity_judgment dispositions (including DISTINCT for REJECT where mapped).

relations.name: purpose_c_commercial_dependency
relations.meaning: Purpose C output row: contract-centric commercial dependency with sorted obligation kinds and status dependent or unresolved under Purpose C conjunction policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs: contract_record, active_contract_judgment, obligation_kind_judgment, open_invoice, identity_judgment, typed_identifier; status unresolved when required identity joins are UNRESOLVED.
relations.construction_rule: C4: for each contract with ACTIVE status and at least one ACCEPT obligation_kind_judgment, evaluate current-relationship leg (open invoice or auto-renewal/rolling_term obligation) and identity joins; emit dependent when both dependency legs hold with confident identity, else unresolved when blocked only by identity.
